text: I walk by faith today and not by what I see with my eyes.
bibleVerseText: For we live by faith, not by sight.

text: I have the faith of a mustard seed, and I can move mountains.
bibleVerseText: Truly I tell you, if you have faith as small as a mustard seed, you can say to this mountain, 'Move from here to there,' and it will move.

text: I am confident that all things are possible for me because I believe.
bibleVerseText: Everything is possible for one who believes.

text: I am fully persuaded that God is able to do what He has promised.
bibleVerseText: Being fully persuaded that God had power to do what he had promised.

text: I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave Himself for me.
bibleVerseText: The life I now live in the body, I live by faith in the Son of God.

text: I shield myself with faith, which stops every attack of the enemy.
bibleVerseText: In addition to all this, take up the shield of faith, with which you can extinguish all the flaming arrows of the evil one.

text: My faith rises as I hear the Word of God and act on what I hear.
bibleVerseText: Consequently, faith comes from hearing the message, and the message is heard through the word about Christ.

text: I am an overcomer because my faith gives me the victory over the world.
bibleVerseText: For everyone born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world, even our faith.

text: I please God by trusting Him with my whole heart.
bibleVerseText: And without faith it is impossible to please God.

text: I ask in bold faith and receive abundantly from the hand of the Lord.
bibleVerseText: But when you ask, you must believe and not doubt.

text: I am justified by faith and I have peace with God.
bibleVerseText: Therefore, since we have been justified through faith, we have peace with God.

text: I am a child of God through faith in Christ Jesus.
bibleVerseText: So in Christ Jesus you are all children of God through faith.

text: I receive what I pray for because I believe that I have already received it.
bibleVerseText: Therefore I tell you, whatever you ask for in prayer, believe that you have received it, and it will be yours.

text: I stand firm in my faith, courageous and unshaken in the face of every storm.
bibleVerseText: Be on your guard; stand firm in the faith; be courageous; be strong.

text: I am saved by grace through faith, and it is a gift from God.
bibleVerseText: For it is by grace you have been saved, through faith—and this is not from yourselves, it is the gift of God.

text: I hold fast to the confession of my faith without wavering.
bibleVerseText: Let us hold unswervingly to the hope we profess, for he who promised is faithful.

text: My faith grows stronger through every trial and God is producing something great in me.
bibleVerseText: Because you know that the testing of your faith produces perseverance.

text: I have the faith to be healed and I am made whole.
bibleVerseText: He said to her, 'Daughter, your faith has healed you. Go in peace.'

text: I am looking unto Jesus, the author and finisher of my faith.
bibleVerseText: Fixing our eyes on Jesus, the pioneer and perfecter of faith.

text: I live by faith, and I am the righteous one in God's eyes.
bibleVerseText: The righteous will live by their faith.

text: I have the faith that moves God to act on my behalf.
bibleVerseText: When Jesus saw their faith, he said to the paralyzed man, 'Son, your sins are forgiven.'

text: I don't need to see it to believe it — my faith is the evidence.
bibleVerseText: Now faith is confidence in what we hope for and assurance about what we do not see.

text: When everything in my circumstances says no, my faith says God already said yes.
bibleVerseText: For no matter how many promises God has made, they are 'Yes' in Christ.

text: I am fully persuaded: the God who raised Jesus from the dead is not finished with my situation.
bibleVerseText: He was fully persuaded that God had power to do what he had promised.

text: My faith rests not in my own strength but in the faithfulness of a God who cannot lie.
bibleVerseText: If we are faithless, he remains faithful, for he cannot disown himself.

text: Like Abraham I call things that are not as though they are and speak life over every dead place.
bibleVerseText: ...the God who gives life to the dead and calls into being things that were not.

text: My faith grows stronger every time God's Word rises above my feelings.
bibleVerseText: In the same way, faith by itself, if it is not accompanied by action, is dead.

text: I bring the impossible before God and watch faith turn it into testimony.
bibleVerseText: With man this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.

text: My faith anchors me to God right in the middle of the storm.
bibleVerseText: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.

text: I walk in the righteousness of God through faith in Christ Jesus and I am already approved.
bibleVerseText: And be found in him, not having a righteousness of my own that comes from the law, but that which is through faith in Christ.

text: God loves me most powerfully not when I have it together but when I don't.
bibleVerseText: But he said to me, 'My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.'

text: I receive a constant flow of blessings and favor that I did not have to earn.
bibleVerseText: Out of his fullness we have all received grace in place of grace already given.

text: I can talk to God with total confidence because He is always ready to help me.
bibleVerseText: Let us then approach God's throne of grace with confidence, so that we may receive mercy and find grace to help us in our time of need.

text: Everything good in me is Christ working through me by grace and His life is the source of all.
bibleVerseText: By the grace of God I am what I am, and his grace to me was not without effect.

text: God has forgiven every failure and given me a completely new beginning.
bibleVerseText: And all are justified freely by his grace through the redemption that came by Christ Jesus.

text: No matter how much I mess up God has even more love and grace for me.
bibleVerseText: But where sin increased, grace increased all the more.

text: I am saved by grace — a gift from God that no human effort could ever buy or earn.
bibleVerseText: For it is by grace you have been saved, through faith—and this is not from yourselves, it is the gift of God.

text: I am free from guilt and shame because God's grace is now in charge of my life.
bibleVerseText: For sin shall no longer be your master, because you are not under the law, but under grace.

text: God chose me and called me to do great things before I was even born.
bibleVerseText: But when God, who set me apart from my mother's womb and called me by his grace, was pleased to reveal his Son in me.

text: God gives me more than enough of everything I need to do good work.
bibleVerseText: And God is able to bless you abundantly, so that in all things at all times, having all that you need, you will abound in every good work.

text: His yoke is easy and His burden is light — He carries every weight alongside me.
bibleVerseText: For my yoke is easy and my burden is light.

text: I lead from overflow, not exhaustion, because God is my source and rest is my foundation.
bibleVerseText: Not by might nor by power, but by my Spirit, says the Lord Almighty.

text: My mistakes do not stop me because God always helps me get back on my feet.
bibleVerseText: The God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory in Christ, after you have suffered a little while, will himself restore you.

text: I am strong in the grace of Christ Jesus and grace carries me through every challenge.
bibleVerseText: You then, my son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.

text: I stand before God fully accepted, clothed in the righteousness of Christ, not my own.
bibleVerseText: To the praise of the glory of His grace, by which He made us accepted in the Beloved.

text: My whole life is a story that shows everyone how kind and good God is.
bibleVerseText: I consider my life worth nothing to me... the task of testifying to the good news of God's grace.

text: New doors open for me because God's favor is like a shield all around me.
bibleVerseText: For you, Lord, bless the righteous; you surround them with your favor as with a shield.

text: I no longer carry the shame of my past — Christ took it all and I am free.
bibleVerseText: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.

text: I am being transformed not by trying harder but by beholding Him and being changed from glory to glory.
bibleVerseText: We all... are being transformed into his image with ever-increasing glory.

text: God's goodness and love pursue me faithfully every single day of my life.
bibleVerseText: Surely your goodness and love will follow me all the days of my life.

text: I don't have to earn my place at the table — grace already seated me there.
bibleVerseText: For he chose us in him before the creation of the world.

text: When I am most aware of my weakness, I am in the place where grace does its best work.
bibleVerseText: But he said to me, 'My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.'

text: Grace is not permission to stay stuck but the power to become who God always saw me as.
bibleVerseText: For the grace of God has appeared that offers salvation to all people. It teaches us to say 'No' to ungodliness.

text: I receive grace upon grace and an endless supply covers every gap, every failure, and every lack.
bibleVerseText: From his fullness we have all received, grace upon grace.

text: My biggest mess became God's greatest message — that is exactly what grace does.
bibleVerseText: And we know that in all things God works for the good of those who love him.

text: I walk in the riches of God's grace where every debt is cancelled and every sin is fully forgiven.
bibleVerseText: In him we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, in accordance with the riches of God's grace.

text: I am justified by His grace and I live as a full heir of every promise He has made.
bibleVerseText: So that, having been justified by his grace, we might become heirs having the hope of eternal life.

text: Grace is the firm foundation of everything I am — not my effort, not my performance.
bibleVerseText: I do not set aside the grace of God, for if righteousness could be gained through the law, Christ died for nothing.

text: I live under grace and not under the weight of works because grace is the ground I stand on.
bibleVerseText: And if by grace, then it cannot be based on works; if it were, grace would no longer be grace.

text: I receive the grace of God fully and let it produce everything He intended in my life.
bibleVerseText: As God's co-workers we urge you not to receive God's grace in vain.

text: I sleep in peace every night because God alone is my safety and my shelter.
bibleVerseText: In peace I will lie down and sleep, for you alone, Lord, make me dwell in safety.

text: My heavy burdens belong to God — He has given my soul the rest I was made for.
bibleVerseText: Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.

text: I am still. The Lord is fighting for me and I don't have to do anything but rest.
bibleVerseText: The Lord will fight for you; you need only to be still.

text: I have a peace that makes no sense to the world because God is guarding my heart.
bibleVerseText: And the peace of God, which transcends all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds.

text: In quiet rest before the Lord, strength rises up in me without any striving.
bibleVerseText: In repentance and rest is your salvation, in quietness and trust is your strength.

text: I am led by the Spirit to a place of quietness and total refreshment.
bibleVerseText: He makes me lie down in green pastures, he leads me beside quiet waters, he refreshes my soul.

text: God holds every anxious thought — He cares for every detail of my life and I am at peace.
bibleVerseText: Cast all your anxiety on him because he cares for you.

text: I live in the shadow of the Almighty where no harm can ever reach me.
bibleVerseText: Whoever dwells in the shelter of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.

text: I trust God to provide for me even while I am resting.
bibleVerseText: In vain you rise early and stay up late... for he grants sleep to those he loves.

text: My mind is set on God and He keeps me in perfect peace.
bibleVerseText: You will keep in perfect peace those whose minds are steadfast, because they trust in you.

text: My true rest is in God alone — He is the source of all my hope.
bibleVerseText: Yes, my soul, find rest in God; my hope comes from him.

text: I walk through the day with a calm heart because God is right beside me.
bibleVerseText: The Lord is near to all who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.

text: God's rest is already mine — His promises are true and I am completely at peace.
bibleVerseText: Now we who have believed enter that rest.

text: God's mercy is new every morning — the past is gone and I am held in His love today.
bibleVerseText: Because of the Lord's great love we are not consumed... his compassions never fail. They are new every morning.

text: I am like a child resting safely in the arms of a loving Father.
bibleVerseText: But I have calmed and quieted myself, I am like a weaned child with its mother.

text: The peace of God rules my heart and guides every step I take.
bibleVerseText: Let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts, since as members of one body you were called to peace.

text: God is my strength and my shield — rest is not weakness, it is trust in Him.
bibleVerseText: The Lord is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in him, and he helps me.

text: I enter the Sabbath rest God has prepared for His people and receive the renewal that only He can give.
bibleVerseText: There remains, then, a Sabbath-rest for the people of God.

text: Being close to God fills me with deep satisfaction and rest — nothing else comes close.
bibleVerseText: You will fill me with joy in your presence, with eternal pleasures at your right hand.

text: God has already given me peace and nothing can take it away from me.
bibleVerseText: The Lord gives strength to his people; the Lord blesses his people with peace.

text: I rest in the fact that God is for me and nothing can stand against me.
bibleVerseText: What, then, shall we say in response to these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?

text: God's goodness is the last thing on my mind each night and I rest deeply in His love.
bibleVerseText: Return to your rest, my soul, for the Lord has been good to you.

text: The weight I was never meant to carry is already gone — His yoke is lighter than I ever imagined.
bibleVerseText: Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.

text: I work from a place of rest and not rest from a place of exhaustion.
bibleVerseText: In repentance and rest is your salvation, in quietness and trust is your strength.

text: In the stillness, God has been speaking all along — my soul is at rest and I can hear Him.
bibleVerseText: Be still, and know that I am God.

text: Even when life is loud and my mind is racing I carry a secret place of peace within me.
bibleVerseText: Whoever dwells in the shelter of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.

text: I dwell in the rest of God where striving ceases and His strength sustains me through every season.
bibleVerseText: But those who hope in the Lord will renew their strength. They will soar on wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary, they will walk and not be faint.

text: I am still in my spirit and that stillness is where God speaks loudest.
bibleVerseText: When you lie down, you will not be afraid; when you lie down, your sleep will be sweet.

text: My peace is not dependent on my circumstances but anchored in the unchanging faithfulness of God.
bibleVerseText: Peace I leave with you; my peace I give you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled and do not be afraid.

text: I rest deeply because God loves me, keeps me, and is never finished working on my behalf.
bibleVerseText: The Lord your God is with you, the Mighty Warrior who saves. He will take great delight in you; in his love he will no longer rebuke you, but will rejoice over you with singing.

text: I do not second-guess what God called me to do — He will see it through.
bibleVerseText: The one who calls you is faithful, and he will do it.

text: I don't shrink in rooms built for me — I walk in and I own it.
bibleVerseText: For it is God who works in you to will and to act in order to fulfill his good purpose.

text: Fear of what people think no longer has power over me. I live for the approval of One.
bibleVerseText: Am I now trying to win the approval of human beings, or of God? Or am I trying to please people? If I were still trying to please people, I would not be a servant of Christ.

text: I don't wait to feel ready — I move the moment God says move.
bibleVerseText: Have I not commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged, for the Lord your God will be with you wherever you go.

text: I was made to stand out for His glory, not to blend in.
bibleVerseText: You are the light of the world. A town built on a hill cannot be hidden.

text: The Spirit in me is greater than anything I face — I don't have to shrink back.
bibleVerseText: The one who is in you is greater than the one who is in the world.

text: I am not disqualified by my history. Every person God ever used was broken before they were bold.
bibleVerseText: But God chose the foolish things of the world to shame the wise; God chose the weak things of the world to shame the strong.

text: My confidence doesn't come from having all the answers — it comes from knowing the One who does.
bibleVerseText: Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding.

text: I step forward into the unknown knowing the same God who parted the sea is walking with me.
bibleVerseText: The Lord himself goes before you and will be with you; he will never leave you nor forsake you.

text: I carry a quiet, unshakeable boldness that only comes from time spent with God — and it shows.
bibleVerseText: When they saw the courage of Peter and John and realized that they were unschooled, ordinary men, they were astonished and they took note that these men had been with Jesus.
